idea: Notes and PYQ papers for my college, sold to juniors before exams. I have about 8,000 rupees saved.

strategist.problem: A first or second year student at this college, 5-10 days before an end-semester exam, cannot find which PYQ questions repeat and has no senior's notes for that exact subject, so they panic-scroll WhatsApp groups and photocopy shops at ₹50-100 per paper.
strategist.target_customer: First and second year engineering students at the founder's own college in India, spending ₹100-300 of their own or parents' money per subject when exam dates are announced, who already ask seniors in class WhatsApp groups for notes and PYQs.
strategist.mission: Sell one exam-ready bundle of senior-curated notes and past-year papers per subject to juniors at our own college, so they revise from a proven question pattern instead of hunting for scraps.

competitors.name: Photocopy and stationery shops near campus selling printed PYQ booklets
competitors.differentiator: Our bundle is searchable, phone-first, updated with the latest semester, and delivered instantly on UPI instead of a queue and a ₹50-100 printout.

competitors.name: Free Telegram and WhatsApp PYQ dump groups run by seniors
competitors.differentiator: We curate, unit-tag and structure the same papers with notes, so a buyer gets a revision path, not 200 unsorted PDFs.

competitors.name: Generic national platforms like Unacademy, Byju's and Toppr selling all-India courses
competitors.differentiator: We only cover this college's exact syllabus, question pattern and paper setter habits, which those platforms cannot match.

scope_cuts: Skip a live doubt-solving chat or mentor feature; notes plus PYQs alone justify the first sale and mentorship burns the founder's 15 hours a week.
Skip a multi-college or all-India rollout; one campus keeps content accurate and word-of-mouth inside class groups fast.
Skip building a native Android/iOS app in weeks 1-4; a mobile web checkout plus PDF delivery is enough to take the first UPI payment.

mvp_features: Subject bundle page with unit-tagged PYQ question list and senior notes PDFs, unlocked after UPI payment via Razorpay checkout.
Razorpay payment link per subject bundle with automatic PDF delivery link sent to the buyer's email after payment.
WhatsApp Business catalogue of subject bundles so juniors browse and pay from class groups.

first_10_steps: Run `npx create-next-app@latest exam-notes --ts --tailwind` and push the repo to GitHub.
Sign up at supabase.com free tier, create a `subjects` and `purchases` table, enable email auth.
Sign up at razorpay.com standard, complete KYC, and create one payment link per subject bundle.
Scan 3 subjects' worth of PYQ papers and notes as PDFs, upload to a Google Drive folder with view-only links.
Prompt Claude to tag every PYQ question with unit number and repeat-count, paste output into the subject page.
Build the subject bundle page and checkout flow with `npx create-next-app` components plus Razorpay checkout script.
Deploy to Netlify free tier and connect a ₹75/month .in domain.
Set up Resend free with one template email that sends the Drive link after purchase.
Create WhatsApp Business catalogue with 3 subject bundles and post the link to 2 class WhatsApp groups.
Send 10 personalised WhatsApp DMs to first-year students offering the first bundle at a launch discount.

burn_line_items.item: Razorpay Standard (2% + GST per transaction, deducted from revenue)

revenue_targets.notes: 3 single subject bundles at ₹149 + 1 semester pack at ₹599 + 1 single at ₹149 = ₹1195; blended with upsells target ₹1245.
Exam-date announcements push juniors to buy; mix shifts toward ₹599 semester packs.
Two full batches of first-years reached via class WhatsApp groups and referral forwards.

key_assumptions: A first/second year student at this college will pay ₹149-₹999 of their own or parents' money for one exam-ready subject bundle when exam dates are announced, based on the ₹50-100 photocopy spend they already make per paper.
Delivery cost per customer is ₹12/month covering Google Drive storage, Resend email quota share and Razorpay's 2% fee amortised; Razorpay fee is deducted from revenue, not billed as burn.
Founder spends 15 hours/week on curation and support with no salary drawn, so labour is not in burn.
Blended revenue per paying customer of ₹249 assumes roughly 60% single-subject buyers at ₹149 and 40% semester-pack buyers at ₹599.

channels.name: Class and hostel WhatsApp groups (own college)
channels.tactic: Post one bundle offer to 6 class/hostel WhatsApp groups per week + 15 personalised WhatsApp DMs/day to first/second year students in those groups during exam-date announcements.

channels.name: Instagram Reels of unit-tagged PYQ sample
channels.tactic: Post 1 Reel/day on Instagram showing a unit-tagged PYQ repeat-count sample for one subject, DM anyone who reacts or comments with a free 1-page sample PDF.

first_10_customers: List every WhatsApp class group and hostel group you're in; post the ₹149 single-subject offer with a free 1-page sample PDF link in 6 groups on day 1.
Personally DM 15 first/second year students you know by name in those groups, day 1-10, each with the cold message below.
Walk your own class before lecture starts and show 10 batchmates the unit-tagged PYQ repeat-count sheet on your phone; take UPI on the spot.
Ask 3 hostel-room neighbours to forward your bundle link into their branch's groups; give them the ₹149 bundle free if 2 of their forwards convert.
Post 1 Instagram Reel/day for 14 days showing a PYQ repeat-count sample; reply to every comment/DM within 1 hour with the free sample PDF.
Offer the first 10 buyers a semester-pack upgrade at single-subject price if they screenshot the bundle to their own WhatsApp status.
growth.cold_message:
Hi! I'm compiling this semester's PYQ papers for [Subject] with unit tags and repeat counts — which questions the setter asks every year.
Send me your email and I'll drop a free 1-page sample of the repeat-count sheet, no payment needed.
If it helps, the full bundle (notes + all PYQs) is ₹149 on UPI, delivered instantly before exams.

objections.objection: I can get the same PYQs free from Telegram/WhatsApp groups.
objections.response: Those are 200 unsorted PDFs; my bundle tags every question by unit with repeat counts so you revise only what's asked — here's the free 1-page sample to compare.
It's less than one photocopy-shop printout at ₹50-100 per paper; pay ₹149 once for all PYQs plus notes, and if it doesn't help you revise I'll refund via UPI.

critic.verdict: The plan stays faithful to the original idea — selling exam-ready notes and PYQ bundles to juniors on the founder's own campus — and fits a student founder's budget, hours and campus-first launch. Pricing (₹149-999) is realistic against the ₹50-100 photocopy spend juniors already make, and the WhatsApp/Instagram channel mix matches where these buyers actually are. The main weakness is timing: exam-date announcements are the purchase trigger, but the plan doesn't explicitly gate the launch push to those windows.
critic.biggest_risk: The purchase is highly seasonal around exam-date announcements; if the founder launches outside those 1-2 week windows, WhatsApp posts and DMs will get ignored and the 30/60/90-day revenue targets will slip badly.
